from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """Financial metric data for one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="Diluted earnings per share value")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the metric")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_metrics: list[CompanyFinancialMetric]
